mapper.select: select doc_id from mst_doc where upper(doc_no) = upper(#{docNo}) and use_yn = 'Y' order by doc_id limit 1

with net as ( select n.lot_id, n.insp_id, n.item_id, n.unit_cd, n.source, n.status, n.occurred_at, greatest(n.nc_qty - coalesce((select sum(d.qty) from qms_ncr_disp d where d.ncr_id = n.ncr_id and d.disp_type = 'USE_AS_IS'), 0), 0) as net_qty from qms_ncr n join lot_master l on l.lot_id = n.lot_id where l.supplier_cust_id = #{custId} and n.status <> 'CANCELLED' ), live as ( select distinct on (h.lot_id) h.lot_id, h.insp_id, h.result, h.judged_at, l.item_id, l.unit_cd, l.qty_created from qms_insp h join lot_master l on l.lot_id = h.lot_id where h.insp_type = 'RECEIVE' and h.status = 'JUDGED' and l.supplier_cust_id = #{custId} order by h.lot_id, h.judged_at desc, h.insp_id desc ), lots as ( -- 분모 LOT(LOT 당 한 번): 살아 있는 최근 판정이 기간 안 + 판정이 모두 무효인데 그 근거 검사로 불량(출처 INSP NCR)을 낸 LOT(QE-1) select v.lot_id, v.item_id, v.unit_cd, v.qty_created, 1 as judged, case when v.result = 'NG' then 1 else 0 end as ng from live v where v.judged_at >= #{fromTs} and v.judged_at < #{toTs} union all select x.lot_id, l.item_id, l.unit_cd, l.qty_created, 0, 0 from (select distinct t.lot_id from net t join qms_insp b on b.insp_id = t.insp_id left join live v on v.lot_id = t.lot_id where t.source = 'INSP' and v.lot_id is null and b.judged_at >= #{fromTs} and b.judged_at < #{toTs}) x join lot_master l on l.lot_id = x.lot_id ), insp as ( select item_id, unit_cd, sum(qty_created) as inspected_qty, sum(judged) as inspection_cnt, sum(ng) as ng_cnt from lots group by item_id, unit_cd ), rej as ( -- 출처 INSP NCR 은 근거 검사의 재검사·무효와 무관하게 그 LOT 에 붙는다(QQ-1): 기준 시각 = LOT 의 살아 있는 최근 판정, -- 살아 있는 판정이 없으면(모두 무효) 근거 검사의 판정 시각 select t.item_id, t.unit_cd, sum(t.net_qty) as rejected_qty, count(*) filter (where t.status in ('OPEN', 'PENDING')) as open_cnt from net t left join live v on v.lot_id = t.lot_id left join qms_insp b on b.insp_id = t.insp_id where t.source = 'INSP' and coalesce(v.judged_at, b.judged_at) >= #{fromTs} and coalesce(v.judged_at, b.judged_at) < #{toTs} group by t.item_id, t.unit_cd ), other as ( select t.item_id, t.unit_cd, sum(t.net_qty) as other_qty from net t where t.source <> 'INSP' and t.occurred_at >= #{fromTs} and t.occurred_at < #{toTs} group by t.item_id, t.unit_cd ), keys as ( select item_id, unit_cd from insp union select item_id, unit_cd from rej union select item_id, unit_cd from other ) select k.item_id, i.item_cd, k.unit_cd, coalesce(a.inspected_qty, 0) as inspected_qty, coalesce(r.rejected_qty, 0) as rejected_qty, coalesce(a.inspection_cnt, 0)::int as inspection_cnt, coalesce(a.ng_cnt, 0)::int as ng_cnt, coalesce(r.open_cnt, 0)::int as open_ncr_cnt, coalesce(o.other_qty, 0) as other_nc_qty from keys k join mst_item i on i.item_id = k.item_id left join insp a on a.item_id = k.item_id and a.unit_cd = k.unit_cd left join rej r on r.item_id = k.item_id and r.unit_cd = k.unit_cd left join other o on o.item_id = k.item_id and o.unit_cd = k.unit_cd order by i.item_cd, k.unit_cd

select n.ncr_id, n.ncr_no, d.line_no, n.lot_id, l.lot_no, l.supplier_lot_no, n.item_id, i.item_cd, d.qty, n.unit_cd, f.defect_cd, f.defect_nm, n.closed_at from qms_ncr n join qms_ncr_disp d on d.ncr_id = n.ncr_id and d.disp_type = 'RETURN' join lot_master l on l.lot_id = n.lot_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = n.item_id left join qms_defect f on f.defect_id = n.defect_id where n.status = 'CLOSED' and l.supplier_cust_id = #{custId} and n.closed_at >= #{fromTs} and n.closed_at < #{toTs} order by n.closed_at, n.ncr_id, d.line_no limit #{limit}
mapper.sql: select n.ncr_id, n.ncr_no, n.status, n.source, n.lot_id, l.lot_no, l.supplier_lot_no, l.supplier_cust_id, n.item_id, i.item_cd, n.nc_qty, coalesce((select sum(d.qty) from qms_ncr_disp d where d.ncr_id = n.ncr_id and d.disp_type = 'RETURN'), 0) as return_qty, n.unit_cd, f.defect_cd, f.defect_nm, n.description, h.insp_no, n.occurred_at, n.closed_at from qms_ncr n join lot_master l on l.lot_id = n.lot_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = n.item_id left join qms_defect f on f.defect_id = n.defect_id left join qms_insp h on h.insp_id = n.insp_id
mapper.select: select l.line_no, l.char_id, c.char_no, c.char_nm, l.special_cls, l.data_type, l.nominal, l.lsl, l.usl, l.unit_nm, l.scale, l.method_nm, l.gauge_class, s.plan_cd as sampling_plan_cd, l.freq_type, l.freq_n, l.reaction_plan from qms_insp_plan_line l join qms_char c on c.char_id = l.char_id join qms_sampling_plan s on s.sampling_plan_id = l.sampling_plan_id where l.insp_plan_id = #{planId} order by l.line_no
select insp_plan_id, insp_type, item_id, item_class_id, proc_id, alt_no, rev, status from qms_insp_plan where insp_plan_id in #{id} order by insp_plan_id

select c.eco_id, c.eco_no, array_to_string(c.m4_types, ',') as m4_text, c.before_desc, c.after_desc, c.reason_desc, c.impact_desc, c.revert_cond, (select string_agg(x.char_id::text, ',' order by x.line_no) from qms_change_char x where x.eco_id = c.eco_id and x.char_id is not null) as char_id_text, (select string_agg(x.insp_plan_id::text, ',' order by x.line_no) from qms_change_char x where x.eco_id = c.eco_id and x.insp_plan_id is not null) as insp_plan_id_text from qms_change c where c.eco_id in #{id} order by c.eco_id
